retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, warm-toned portrait featuring a mix of condensed block lettering and expressive hand-drawn script.

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, three-quarter view portrait of a man with feathered hair, bathed in intense amber and orange light against a deep black background, featuring stark white typography in opposite corners.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm amber skin tones against a void-like black background
Stark white typography providing high-contrast balance
Diagonal tension between top-left and bottom-right text blocks
Soft focus on hair contrasting with sharp facial features
coreInvariants: Intense orange-to-red color cast on the subject's face
Deep black negative space on the right side
White text with irregular, hand-crafted edges

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject's face occupies the left two-thirds of the frame in a large-scale close-up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The brightly lit bridge of the nose and eyes serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the top-left block text, down the bridge of the nose, to the bottom-right script.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black negative space in the bottom right quadrant provides a canvas for the secondary text.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant amber and orange midtones on the skin
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for all typographic elements
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the warm tones with extreme value contrast between the subject and the background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Condensed sans-serif and casual brush script
letterConstructionRules: Top text: Tall, condensed, irregular block letters with varying widths.
Bottom text: Loose, gestural hand-drawn script with uneven baselines.
All strokes appear slightly distressed or hand-painted.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' in the primary name is significantly enlarged to act as a visual anchor.
The 'y' and 'g' in the script have elongated, expressive descenders.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between rigid, condensed block forms and fluid, organic handwriting.

preserve: Condensed proportions of the top text
Hand-drawn feel of the bottom text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the condensed, rugged block feel of the top text.
Mimics the casual, handwritten quality of the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a close-up portrait of a man with 80s-style feathered hair, lit with a strong amber and orange key light from the side, with the other side of the frame falling into deep black shadow.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add white, hand-drawn condensed block lettering in the top-left corner and a loose, white brush-script title in the bottom-right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the background pure black in the shadows?
Are there two distinct styles of white typography?

mustRedesign: Avoid using standard Arial or Helvetica
Do not use blue or cool-toned lighting
postGenerationChecks: Check for high contrast between skin and background
Ensure the 'S' in the top text is larger than surrounding letters
Confirm the bottom text has a 'hand-written' appearance
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast amber portrait + condensed block header + gestural script footer.
